stories.headline: ASML posts record €11.7B quarter, says it cannot fully meet AI-driven demand in 2027-2028

key_facts.fact: ASML reported record Q3 2026 total net sales of €11.7 billion, a 57.5% gross margin and net income of €5.0 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Q3 total net sales of €11.7 billion, gross margin of 57.5%, net income of €5.0 billion

key_facts.fact: ASML said its supply as currently planned for both 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet customer demand, and it is investigating ways to raise 2028 capacity beyond the 30% increase previously communicated.
key_facts.excerpt: we now expect that our supply as currently planned for both 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet the demand of our customers. Given this, we are investigating ways to increase capacity for 2028 beyond the 30% increase we previously communicated.

key_facts.fact: CEO Christophe Fouquet said some customers are expressing interest in placing orders for 2029 and even 2030, driven by their views on the size and duration of AI investments.
key_facts.excerpt: In light of their demand visibility, some customers are expressing an interest in placing orders with us for 2029 and even 2030.

key_facts.fact: ASML guided Q4 2026 sales of €14.2-15.2 billion and full-year 2026 sales of €44-45 billion with a gross margin around 56%.
key_facts.excerpt: We expect fourth-quarter 2026 total net sales between €14.2 billion and €15.2 billion... total net sales for 2026 to be between €44 billion and €45 billion, with a gross margin around 56%

key_facts.fact: ASML expects to ship roughly 65 low-NA EUV systems in 2026, nearly 50% more than the 44 shipped in 2025; Q3 EUV system sales were €4.1 billion, including one High-NA EUV system.
key_facts.excerpt: For low-NA EUV, we anticipate output of roughly 65 systems for 2026, which is nearly 50% more than the 44 systems that we shipped last year... EUR 4.1 billion from EUV system sales, including the sale of one High-NA EUV system

key_facts.fact: Q3 net system sales were split 54% logic and 46% memory; Installed Base Management sales of €3.3 billion beat guidance by almost €0.4 billion on demand for productivity upgrades.
key_facts.excerpt: Net system sales were split between logic at 54% and memory at 46%. Installed base management sales for the quarter were EUR 3.3 billion, exceeding our guidance by almost EUR 0.4 billion

stories.headline: Japan to fund up to $21B for two GlobalFoundries-run fabs in New York; US takes 4% stake

key_facts.fact: GlobalFoundries was selected as technology provider and operator for two new fabs at its Malta, New York, site under a US-Japan initiative providing up to $21 billion, with Japan supplying the investment.
key_facts.excerpt: GlobalFoundries... today announced it has been selected as the technology provider and operator for two new semiconductor manufacturing facilities ("fabs") at its Malta, New York, site under a U.S.-Japan initiative providing up to $21 billion in funding.

key_facts.fact: An initial ~$10 billion will build a 300mm fab expected online in 2029, with another ~$10 billion for a second fab; each adds about 900,000 300mm wafers of annual capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: The initial approximately $10 billion investment is to accelerate construction of a new 300mm fab expected to come online in 2029, with an additional approximately $10 billion for a second fab; each fab is expected to add approximately 900,000 300mm wafers of annual U.S. manufacturing capacity

key_facts.fact: In a separate agreement the US Commerce Department will receive about 4% equity in GlobalFoundries, bringing the US government's stake to about 7%, CEO Tim Breen told Reuters.
key_facts.excerpt: In a separate agreement, the U.S. government will take a 4% stake in GlobalFoundries, bringing its total ownership of the chipmaker to about 7%, GlobalFoundries CEO Tim Breen told Reuters.

key_facts.fact: The move is part of Japan's $550 billion US investment pledge, agreed in exchange for lower US tariffs on Japanese cars and other imports.
key_facts.excerpt: The move is part of a deal for Japan to invest $550 billion in the U.S. struck by President Donald Trump's administration last year in return for the U.S. lowering tariffs on Japanese cars and other imports from at least 25% to 15%.

key_facts.fact: GlobalFoundries also reallocated $955 million of its CHIPS Act award toward silicon photonics, silicon-germanium and advanced packaging in Malta, NY, and Burlington, Vermont.
key_facts.excerpt: amend its existing CHIPS and Science Act award to reallocate $955 million and accelerate the company's investments in silicon photonics, silicon-germanium (SiGe) and advanced packaging

key_facts.fact: GlobalFoundries is majority-owned by Abu Dhabi's Mubadala Investment Company.
key_facts.excerpt: The company is majority owned by Abu Dhabi's Mubadala Investment Company.

key_facts.fact: The project is expected to create about 27,000 construction and ecosystem jobs and more than 1,000 manufacturing jobs; Renesas said it is planning around the new capacity as an extension of its own production footprint.
key_facts.excerpt: the project is expected to create about 27,000 construction and ecosystem jobs and more than 1,000 high-skilled manufacturing jobs... We are planning around GF's new capacity in New York as an extension of Renesas own production footprint

stories.headline: EU set to lift sanction on Chinese firm to save ASML supplier Sindlhauser from Beijing controls

key_facts.fact: The EU is negotiating with China to lift restrictions on an unnamed Chinese company in exchange for Beijing lifting sanctions on Sindlhauser Materials GmbH, a German supplier to ASML, Bloomberg reported on October 14.
key_facts.excerpt: Binnen de voorgestelde regeling zou de EU handelsbeperkingen opheffen voor een niet nader genoemd Chinees bedrijf... In ruil daarvoor zou Beijing de sancties opheffen die het in juli oplegde aan Sindlhauser Materials GmbH

key_facts.fact: The Chinese company had been accused by the EU of supplying components supporting Russia's war in Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: 作为交换，欧盟将解除对一家中国企业实施的贸易限制。欧盟指控这家企业协助俄罗斯对乌克兰发动战争。

key_facts.fact: China placed Sindlhauser and 13 other EU entities on its export-control list in July, less than a day after the EU's 21st Russia sanctions package, barring them from Chinese-origin dual-use items.
key_facts.excerpt: 今年7月，欧盟公布第21轮对俄制裁后不到一天，中国随即对包括辛德豪瑟材料在内的14家欧盟实体实施出口管制

key_facts.fact: The Bavarian firm depends almost entirely on Chinese rare earths and critical minerals, and officials warn it could go bankrupt within months without them.
key_facts.excerpt: Het bedrijf is vrijwel volledig afhankelijk van Chinese leveranties van zeldzame aardmetalen en kritieke mineralen. Zonder toegang tot die materialen waarschuwen functionarissen dat Sindlhauser Materials GmbH binnen enkele maanden failliet kan gaan.

key_facts.fact: The one-for-one delisting was discussed during EU trade commissioner Maros Sefcovic's recent Beijing visit with Commerce Minister Wang Wentao; the EU is expected to act first.
key_facts.excerpt: De voorgestelde een-op-een schrapping werd besproken tijdens het recente bezoek van EU-handelscommissaris Maros Sefcovic aan Beijing, waar hij de Chinese minister van Handel Wang Wentao ontmoette... De EU zal naar verwachting als eerste handelen

key_facts.fact: Reuters carried the Bloomberg report under the headline 'EU set to lift sanction on Chinese firm to save ASML supplier'.
key_facts.excerpt: Oct 14 (Reuters) – * EU SET TO LIFT SANCTION ON CHINESE FIRM TO SAVE ASML SUPPLIER – BLOOMBERG NEWS

stories.headline: AEP to invest $4B in 702 MW Bloom fuel cell plant to power Google in Wyoming

key_facts.fact: American Electric Power plans to invest about $4 billion in a 702-megawatt fuel cell generation project near Cheyenne, Wyoming, under a 20-year power purchase agreement with Google.
key_facts.excerpt: American Electric Power (Nasdaq: AEP) plans to invest approximately $4 billion to advance a new 702-megawatt fuel cell generation project near Cheyenne, Wyoming, under a long-term 20-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with Google

key_facts.fact: The plant uses Bloom Energy fuel cells that generate electricity without combusting natural gas, and the project plans to integrate carbon capture for near-zero-emissions power.
key_facts.excerpt: The planned facility uses advanced fuel cell technology developed by Bloom Energy... The technology generates electricity without combustion of natural gas, and the project includes plans to integrate carbon capture technology

key_facts.fact: Cheyenne Fuel Cell LLC is about 92% owned by AEP and nearly 8% by funds advised by Basalt Infrastructure Partners; construction starts in 2026 with full operation by end-2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Cheyenne Fuel Cell, LLC, which AEP owns and controls at approximately 92%, with funds advised by Basalt Infrastructure Partners, LLP holding the remaining stake of nearly 8%... AEP and its partners plan to begin construction this year, with full operations expected by the end of 2028.

key_facts.fact: The power supports Google's growing energy needs in the greater Cheyenne area and follows agreements between Google and Black Hills Corp. effective September 30.
key_facts.excerpt: AEP's development and construction of this fuel cell generation facility is supporting Google's growing energy needs in the greater Cheyenne area... The project follows agreements reached between Google and Black Hills Corp., effective Sept. 30.

stories.headline: CoreWeave bond yields near 15% and shares sink as AI-infrastructure debt fears mount

key_facts.fact: The yield on $1.25 billion of CoreWeave unsecured bonds due 2032 touched nearly 15% on Tuesday, October 13, before closing at a record 14.5%.
key_facts.excerpt: the yield on $1.25 billion of CoreWeave's unsecured bonds maturing in 2032 reaching nearly 15% on Tuesday before closing at a record 14.5%

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk replied 'Yikes' on October 13 to Chamath Palihapitiya's chart of the bond yield, which Palihapitiya framed as a possible AI 'private credit bubble'.
key_facts.excerpt: Billionaire Elon Musk responded with a single word—"Yikes"—to a chart showing CoreWeave Inc.'s (NASDAQ: CRWV) bond yield spiking to 15%, which venture capitalist Chamath Palihapitiya shared to warn about a potential "private credit bubble"

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave shares fell about 15% in morning trading on October 14, to as low as $65.55, with Nebius and IREN also selling off.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave shares plunged 15.1% in morning trading... drove CRWV to trade as low as $65.55

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave has raised more than $35 billion this year through chip-backed loans, high-yield and convertible bonds and share sales, with debt and lease obligations of about $52 billion at end-June.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave has raised more than $35 billion this year through a combination of chip-backed loans, high-yield bonds, convertible bonds, and share sales, with debt and lease obligations totaling about $52 billion at the end of June.

key_facts.fact: D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria said CoreWeave borrows at around 9% while earning about 1% returns on its investments.
key_facts.excerpt: D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria warned today that CoreWeave is borrowing money at around 9% while earning returns of just 1% on its investments

key_facts.fact: Co-founder Brannin McBee told the Financial Times CoreWeave wants investment-grade ratings on more chip-backed debt to tap insurers' capital, which he called 'unlimited'.
key_facts.excerpt: McBee... said winning investment-grade ratings for more of its chip-backed debt, and eventually for the company itself, would let it borrow from insurers whose capital "is unlimited."

stories.headline: Nvidia pledges $250M in compute for UK AI safety research, $2B in new European deals

key_facts.fact: Nvidia announced a five-year compute donation valued at $250 million, or $50 million a year, for UK agentic AI safety and security research.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA today announced a five-year compute donation valued at $250 million... The commitment will provide $50 million in compute access annually

key_facts.fact: Part of the compute goes to the BOLD lab, the SOFAIR lab and Imperial College London, delivered via UK-based Nvidia Cloud Partners; provider selection and commercial terms are still to be agreed.
key_facts.excerpt: with a proportion supporting work with the British Open-Ended Learning and Discovery Lab (BOLD), the Science of Fundamental AI Research Lab (SOFAIR) and Imperial College London... Provider selection, technical architecture and commercial terms are to be agreed.

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang said 'AI capability and safety must advance together.'
key_facts.excerpt: "AI capability and safety must advance together," said Jensen Huang, founder and CEO of NVIDIA.

key_facts.fact: In Paris, Huang said Nvidia would announce $2 billion in new European investments within a week, after spending about $8 billion in Europe last year, and disclosed stakes in French startups Doctolib, Genesis AI, Pigment and Entalpic.
key_facts.excerpt: In Paris, he announced $2 billion in new investments across Europe due the following week, Bloomberg reports. Nvidia spent about $8 billion in Europe last year. Huang disclosed new stakes in French startups Doctolib, Genesis AI, Pigment, and Entalpic

key_facts.fact: The donation coincides with the UK confirming its AI Security Institute will be able to examine frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google before release.
key_facts.excerpt: The donation from the world's most valuable company comes as the UK government confirmed its AI Security Institute (AISI)... will be able to examine cutting-edge technology developed by companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google before they are released.

stories.headline: Oxford photonics startup Salience Labs raises $125M, backed by AMD and Intel

key_facts.fact: Salience Labs closed an oversubscribed $125 million Series B led by Bullhound Capital, with AMD Ventures, Intel Capital, SBI Group, Hudson River Trading and British Business Bank participating.
key_facts.excerpt: today announced the successful completion of an oversubscribed $125 million Series B funding round. The round is led by Bullhound Capital... Additional investor participation came from AMD Ventures, Intel Capital, SBI Group, Hudson River Trading and British Business Bank

key_facts.fact: The Oxford spin-out builds all-optical circuit switches that keep data as light to connect thousands of GPUs in AI data centers, aiming to cut power use and latency.
key_facts.excerpt: the company's optical circuit switching (OCS) technology keeps data travelling as light with the aim of reducing power consumption and delays

key_facts.fact: The funding follows a live demo of its 64-port all-optical photonic switch at ECOC 2026 and will fund 128- and 256-port switches, volume manufacturing and a Silicon Valley expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: The financing comes on the heels of Salience Labs' live demo of its 64-port all-optical photonic switch at ECOC 2026... The funding will enable future solutions including 128- and 256- port OCS

key_facts.fact: Nvidia is notably absent from the round despite its spending spree on optical startups such as Ayar Labs and Lumentum.
key_facts.excerpt: No Nvidia, which for a startup developing in-rack optical connectivity is notable given the GPU's ongoing optical spending spree

key_facts.fact: British Business Bank invested £10 million in the round.
key_facts.excerpt: The British Business Bank has invested £10m in Salience Labs
